# Where to Watch Gabriella


by Angel | November 19, 2026


What if you could heal anyone you met, but every miracle took a little of your own life?


After a near-death experience, a young girl named Gabriella meets Jesus and faces an extraordinary choice: stay with Him in Heaven or return to Earth with the ability to heal others in His name.


Gabriella chooses to return. But life on Earth isn’t easy. As she moves from one foster home to another, she uses her gift to help people facing physical, emotional, and spiritual pain. While each healing brings hope to someone else, it comes at a heartbreaking cost to Gabriella.


Her story raises a powerful question: How much would you give to help someone else?


[Watch Gabriella now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/gabriella)


### **The Power of Faith, Love, and Sacrifice**


At its heart, *Gabriella* is about the kind of love that puts others first. Gabriella willingly gives up the comfort of Heaven to help people on Earth, even when she knows her gift will cost her.


Her journey explores the power of faith and the impact one person can have on the lives of others. It also offers a reminder that healing can reach far beyond the physical—it can bring hope, restore relationships, and help people find their way forward.


### **A Heartfelt Story That Stays With You**


Some movies make you laugh, some make you cry, and some leave you thinking long after the credits roll. *Gabriella* offers an emotional journey filled with joy, heartbreak, hope, and love.


Angel Guild members have called it “beautiful and heartwarming” and “incredibly moving.” One viewer shared that the film left them feeling “emotionally wrecked and somehow healed at the same time.”


If you’re looking for a faith-filled story that will move your heart and remind you of the power of selfless love, *Gabriella* is worth watching.


### **Watch** ***Gabriella*** **on Angel**


Gabriella could have stayed in Heaven, but she chose to return and help people who needed her. Discover her extraordinary journey and the true cost of her gift in *Gabriella* .
